A '''Toka crossbow''' was a projectile weapon employed by the [[Sharu/Legends|Toka]] people of the [[Rafa system/Legends|Rafa system]]. It was not an actual [[Crossbow/Legends|crossbow]], but a device with hinged arms, resembling the arms of a crossbow. The hinged arms would flail forward hurling the stubby [[Arrow/Legends|arrow]] out through the front of the weapon. Unlike the crossbow, this weapon did not need to be reloaded after every shot, as it incorporated a magazine of approximately six projectiles, hidden within the mechanism. The Toka crossbow was not very powerful, but the speed and accuracy with which they could be wielded made them a formidable weapon.
